findings.name: bursa_dating_fault
findings.detail: MYX:0820EA, the FBM KLCI ETF used as the Malaysian market proxy (core/market/feed.py:419), has a median 2,800 shares/day over the last 60 sessions against Maybank's 11,027,500 (3,937x) and no trades at all on 164 of 1,231 sessions (13.3%). knowledge/pack.py:112 intersects name and proxy sessions and :120 takes the last; a blank proxy close silently shifts the whole Bursa half one session back.
findings.cost_on_this_page: six Bursa names on the wrong session; three of six have the wrong sign for 2026-09-09 (Tenaga, IHH, Press Metal); Petronas Chemicals is mis-sized not flipped (+3.95% reported, +1.79% actual); Genting -3.98% reported as -1.95% and not attributable
findings.remedy_proposed: ^KLSE, the index itself, rather than an ETF tracking it
findings.remedy_untested_because: Yahoo returns 403 through the sandbox proxy for every symbol, including ones that work on the runner
findings.corrected_after_publication: first published as 'four of six ... (Tenaga, PCHEM, IHH, Press Metal)'. PCHEM is positive on both sessions and does not flip. Three names flip.

findings.name: gdelt_cap_premise
findings.detail: the refusal rate did not fall; on this sample it rose. 15 requests is too small to call the difference significant but is decisively inconsistent with a per-run quota that nine requests exhausted. PR #59 justified a correct change with an incorrect mechanism.
findings.second_finding: the cap only ever binds bursa_close: _window returns the whole list when cap >= len(terms), and us_close sweeps only the three Nasdaq names. Petronas Chemicals was deferred on two of the three capped runs while collecting nothing from Google News either.

findings.name: us_close_cron
findings.detail: the cron was never missing. All 11 scheduled runs in the record fired, late: bursa_close +4h16m..+5h43m, us_preopen +4h07m..+5h21m, us_close +1h59m..+2h16m. The routine fires at 22:34 UTC, inside the us_close delay window every night, so sweep --due reports it due and the catch-up dispatches a duplicate (runs 39, 43, 47, 51).
findings.action_still_correct: it is a pull-forward, not a catch-up: it puts today's US closes in the book about 40 minutes before the delayed cron, and the paper decision is taken in between. Cost: one extra ~3-minute run a night.
findings.consequence: the missed_slot monitor rule (task #50) is measuring GitHub's scheduling delay, not missed slots.

lessons: A proxy must be at least as liquid as the things it explains; liquidity is a precondition for a benchmark, not a quality of it, and nothing in this system checked it before using one.
A change can be right and its justification wrong, and the justification is what the next person inherits.
'It did not run' and 'it has not run yet' are different findings, and a check that fires inside the delay window cannot tell them apart.
Marking a cause unknown is honest; it is not a substitute for looking again the next night.
